title: ReqSpec analyzed 2,294 Spectra-wave requirements in under three minutes
summary: I developed ReqSpec during Project Elevate time-writing and worked with an IGT-D customer to use it on the Spectra-wave product. It analyzed 2,294 requirements in under three minutes and received a 10/10 customer NPS. The customer estimated 18 weeks of manual effort avoided; this was an estimate, not a measured labor reduction.
what_would_have_happened: The customer estimated that manual review would take about 10 minutes per requirement and require at least three engineers plus added coordination for consistent results.
the_call: Build a requirements analysis capability that applies standards-based rules consistently to a large requirements set.
what_i_did: I developed ReqSpec using Project Elevate time-writing and worked with the customer to run it against the Spectra-wave requirements.
what_changed: ReqSpec analyzed 2,294 requirements in under three minutes. The customer rated the engagement 10/10 and estimated 18 weeks of manual effort avoided.
